name: meilisearch
description: Drive any Meilisearch instance (local Docker, self-hosted, or Meilisearch Cloud) from the agent through the official meilisearch-mcp server — manage indices, add and update documents, run typo-tolerant and hybrid (keyword + vector) searches, tune ranking and typo tolerance, manage API keys, and monitor indexing tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Drive any Meilisearch instance through the official MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Your agent can manage and query your Meilisearch search engine — creating indexes, adding documents, tuning search settings, and running typo-tolerant searches. Works with your local Docker instance, self-hosted server, or Meilisearch Cloud. No more using the dashboard for every config change: just ask your agent to index new data, check search performance, or adjust ranking rules.
defaultPrompt: Search my documents for this term with typo tolerance.
Help me index a new set of documents into my search engine.
Check the health and status of my Meilisearch instance.
